name: io.github.sepehr071/tsetmc-mcp
title: TSETMC Tehran Stock Exchange
description: Unofficial read-only Tehran Stock Exchange (TSETMC): quotes, movers, order book, history, indices.

environmentVariables.name: TSETMC_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for tsetmc.com requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
